meta.name: youtube-transcribe-skill
meta.description: Extract subtitles/transcripts from YouTube videos. Triggers: "youtube transcript", "extract subtitles", "video captions", "视频字幕", "字幕提取", "YouTube转文字", "提取字幕".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从YouTube视频中提取字幕或文字记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把YouTube视频的语音或字幕转成文字
copy.tagline_en: Extract subtitles or transcripts from YouTube videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to convert YouTube video speech or captions into text

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据 YouTube 视频链接提取字幕或转录稿，并保存为本地文本文件。
howto.when: 当你提供 YouTube 视频链接，或说出“提取字幕”、“视频字幕”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取这个视频的字幕：https://youtu.be/abc123
say.note: Claude 会下载字幕并保存为 .txt 文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract subtitles or transcripts from a YouTube video URL and save them as a local text file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a YouTube video URL or say keywords like "youtube transcript", "extract subtitles", or "video captions".

say_en.text: Extract subtitles from this video: https://youtu.be/abc123
say_en.note: Claude will download subtitles and save as .txt.
Claude will try CLI extraction first.
